user: Is the deadline the same for every reason code?
answer:
No. Each reason code has its own dispute window, counted in days from the transaction date:

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

A dispute opened after its window closes is not eligible. The 2026-10-18 deadline for TX-0401 matches the 90-day window for `goods_not_received` from the 2026-07-20 transaction date.
